# Open a Genfeed.ai issue

Use the focused form that matches your report:

- [Report a bug](https://github.com/genfeedai/genfeed.ai/issues/new?template=bug.yml)
- [Propose a feature](https://github.com/genfeedai/genfeed.ai/issues/new?template=feature.yml)
- [Define an agent-ready task](https://github.com/genfeedai/genfeed.ai/issues/new?template=task.yml)

Questions, early ideas, and security reports belong in the contact links on the
[issue chooser](https://github.com/genfeedai/genfeed.ai/issues/new/choose).

If none of those paths fit, replace the prompts below with a focused request.

## Context

<!-- What happens today, who is affected, and why does it matter? -->

## Desired outcome

<!-- What observable behavior must be true when this issue is complete? -->

## Acceptance criteria

Use testable outcomes. Prefer `WHEN`, `WHILE`, `WHERE`, or `IF ... THEN`
conditions followed by `THE SYSTEM SHALL` and an observable result. Imperfect
syntax is fine — triage rewrites it, it never closes for phrasing.

- [ ] WHEN ... THE SYSTEM SHALL ...
- [ ] IF ... THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL ...
